how: The score is the average of up to four part scores, each from 0 to 100. Submits on time: each purchase gets points for how many days it took to submit, 100 within a week and then down to 0 after four months. Purchases not submitted yet count by how long they have waited, after the first week, and for a card purchase the count starts when its bank row is in the app. Approved first time: how many of your utlägg went through without being sent back or having their date corrected at booking. Attested correctly: how many of your attests the treasury did not have to send back or correct the date on. Attests on time: 100 within three days of something reaching you and then down to 0 after two months, utlägg and supplier invoices alike, and what is waiting on you counts too. A part score only counts once it has at least three things to go on, so someone who does not attest is scored on what they submit alone. The last six months weigh double. The score has no consequences, it is only there for you.
